'''Carn Truuvik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who worked with [[Catrinna]] and several other beings loyal to him during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The group conned targets out of their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] through rigged [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] games, which they ran at a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] Truuvik owned named [[Bovo's]], near the [[Treasure Ship Row/Legends|Treasure Ship Row]], a street in the [[Blue Sector/Legends|Blue Sector]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SoF" />
